# Adobe Express

> > Adobe Express is a web-based multimedia authoring platform for creating graphics, web pages, and videos with intuitive design tools.

Adobe Express (formerly Adobe Spark) enables users to create professional-quality visual content including social media graphics (Spark Post), multimedia web pages (Spark Page), and animated videos (Spark Video). The platform applies educational principles like dual-coding theory to make content creation accessible to non-designers.

## Key Topics

- Adobe Spark
- Adobe Express
- Spark Post
- Spark Page
- Spark Video
- Multimedia authoring
- Web-based design tools
- Content creation
- Dual-coding theory
- Educational technology
- Visual storytelling
- Social media graphics
